paper.ca_use_tip: Put this number in the open student's points box
paper.ca_stick_tip: Click where it goes on the paper
paper.ca_pct_none: Type a score to see its percent.
paper.snip_drag: Drag over what you want to copy.
paper.snip_drag_page: Drag over what you want to copy, or click a page for all of it.
paper.snip_note_paper: On the paper, name covers are painted in and the student’s name and file names are left off. Anything else shows as it is on screen.
paper.snip_note: Everything shows as it is on screen.
paper.snip_miss_paper: Drag over an area, or click a page.
paper.snip_miss: Drag over an area to copy it.
paper.snip_fail: That picture couldn’t be made. Try a smaller area.
paper.snip_copied: Picture copied. Paste it wherever you need it.
paper.snip_saved: This browser can’t copy pictures, so it was saved as Screenshot.png.
paper.tn_bank_none: No saved comments yet. Save one under the comment, or add them in Settings > Marking.
paper.gs_looking: Looking for the grade on each paper…
paper.gs_help: Every row is made from the file named on it, inside that student’s folder. Click a picture to open that student. Click a score to copy it.
paper.gs_also: Also show grades found on the papers (a score you gave in Grading Studio always counts)
paper.gs_all: Show files with no grade (the downloaded sheet shows the same rows)
paper.gs_trim: Trim each spot down to your marks

paper.gs_out.one: {n} file has no marks, so it’s left out as an extra paper.
paper.gs_out.other: {n} files have no marks, so they’re left out as extra papers.

paper.gs_many: This paper has more than one grade on it, so say which one to use.
paper.gs_type_tip: Type the score you see in the picture
paper.gs_not_all: Not every criterion is highlighted yet
paper.gs_no_stamp: No score stamp on this paper yet. Use Stamp by the total to put your score on it.
paper.gs_seen: No grade in the typed text found: “{text}”
paper.gs_flat: There are marks here but no typed text, so the grade may be handwritten or flattened. Try Box it by hand.
paper.gs_blank: No marks or typed text in this file. If it was marked in Kami, the marks may not have been saved into the file. Try Box it by hand.
paper.gs_yours_is: Your score in Grading Studio is {v}
paper.gs_cant_open: This file couldn’t be opened. Click Skip.
paper.gs_box_help: Drag a box around the grade. It saves and goes to the next paper. Left and right arrows go back and on; Esc finishes.
paper.gs_box_again: already boxed (drag again to change it)
paper.gs_spot_help: Drag a box around where you put the grade. The same spot gets cropped on every paper, which also catches handwritten grades.
